sp_widget.client_script: api.controller = function() { var c = this; c.submitting = false; c.submit = function() { if (!c.data.canSubmit || c.submitting) return; c.submitting = true; c.server.get({ action: "submit" }).then(function(r) { c.data.submitted = r.data.submitted; c.data.canSubmit = r.data.canSubmit; c.data.status = r.data.status; c.submitting = false; }); }; };
